notes: Open the Справочник.Склады list and toggle the delete mark of the current (first) warehouse row, which drives TestedFormTable.SwitchRowDeleteMark (ПереключитьПометкуУдаленияСтроки) via 'в таблице ... я меняю пометку удаления строки'. EMPIRICAL FINDING (capture switchdel-learn1): the method only OPENS the confirmation dialog 'Пометить выбранный элемент на удаление?' — the delete mark is written to the DB only on 'Да', which the capture never clicks; the TestClient is then killed with the dialog pending, so nothing persists. A tabular-section row does NOT support a delete mark (proven: goods-doc-switchdeletemark rejected 'Неподходящий тип элемента управления'), so a dynamic list is required; toggling an EXISTING warehouse keeps the object ref stable across runs (fully_stable) and, because the confirmation is never answered, touches no data — strictly safer and simpler than a throwaway object. vanessa_client only.
